intro: Four quarterly themes, eight campaigns, three launch shows. Each campaign is sold in 4 months ahead, overseas orders close 3 months ahead, domestic stays open to 3 weeks out. Click any bar or marker for the brief.
footnote: Show dates confirmed with organizers as of Sep 29, 2026. SAAC has not published 2027 dates; Impressions Long Beach, Promotions East and SAAC are marked TBD against the $100K show cap. Trade shows and marketing are each capped at $100K; there is no paid digital, the former ad budget funds Hats in Hand sampling.

quarters.name: Launch Season
quarters.goal: Every distributor who matters leaves January knowing three things: a new premium Elite line, a simpler price ladder (Basics $4, Classic $5, Comfort $6, Sport $6.50), and a free decorated sample in their hand.
quarters.promo: Hats in Hand: sign up, pick a style and color, send a logo, get a free domestic spec sample. Launched at PPAI, top-100 distributors first.
quarters.shows: ASI Orlando, PPAI Expo, ASI Fort Worth

quarters.name: Event Season
quarters.goal: King Cap is the fastest way to put a good-looking hat on every head at an event. Overseas if you planned, domestic in 2 to 3 weeks if you did not.
quarters.promo: Event Ready: any stocked blank, decorated at Apollo, ships in 15 business days. Price breaks at 48 / 72 / 100 on the flyer.

quarters.name: Back to School and Game Day
quarters.goal: Fall is hat season. Own schools and game day, and be the first to say "order your December hats in August."
quarters.promo: Company Gift Early Bird: gift programs placed by Aug 15 get overseas pricing and guaranteed pre-Thanksgiving delivery. Launched at ASI Chicago.

quarters.name: Gift Season and 2028 Setup
quarters.goal: To distributors: there is still time, domestic ships in 15 days through Dec 8. To top accounts: thank you, here is 2028, see you at PPAI.
quarters.promo: Year-End Quick Turn: stocked blanks, Versa Tags and patches, 15-day domestic delivery, order by Dec 8. DTC runs Small Business Saturday and Cyber Monday.
